# jqlog

Filter JSON log lines through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/jqlog -f logs.ndjson '.message'

printf '%s\n' '{"level":"info"}' | moonx cli/jqlog '.level'
```

Apply the filter to each valid JSON line and emit compact JSON. Read stdin by default; -f selects a file and a second positional operand is literal input text.

## Notes

- Invalid JSON lines are skipped. A failed filter emits no results for that line, preserves earlier successful output and exits 2.
- Module loading and input/inputs are unavailable. Filters use jq's shared value-filter engine.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
